source: Previously supplied native iPhone Camera screenshots (subset directly mapped to a named style in an annotated contact sheet)
excluded_unassigned_screenshots: Remaining user images include unlabeled amber, picker screens and style groups not reliably mapped here; do not claim they are fitted to any named style.
method: Screenshot color-axis cursor localized from white-dot component; 4 region RGB medians/luminance extracted after resampling to 497x1080; fit 5-point tone curve and per-style chroma axis. Hold one screenshot out when estimating aggregate predictive luminance error; other screenshots have unlocked AE/AWB.
notes: This is NOT a comparison between YCam captured output and iPhone native output. The RGB error below measures leave-one-screenshot-out screen-reference-region simulation and cannot prove real camera output fidelity. Without paired capture from same sensor+locked scene, actual DeltaE is unknown.
